questions: Should the scaling be applied column-wise (per feature) or across the entire dataset (global min-max)?
If all values in a column are identical (e.g., all 5), what should the scaled value be? (MinMaxScaler would produce 0, but could be defined as 0.5 or handle division by zero)
Should the plot be a line plot, bar plot, or some other type? The reference uses df.plot() which defaults to line.
Should the plot include a legend, grid, or specific axis labels? The prompt only specifies title.
If the dictionary has keys that are not strings (e.g., integers), should they be allowed as column names?
Should the function handle uneven list lengths across dictionary values (ragged arrays)?
Is the order of columns in the returned DataFrame important (e.g., sorted alphabetically, or as in dict insertion order)?
Should the function reset the index of the DataFrame after dropping NaN rows?
